pair_intended_person_name_valid.name: pair_intended_person_name_valid
pair_intended_person_name_valid.value: "pair"."intended_person_name" is null or (char_length("pair"."intended_person_name") between 1 and 40 and "pair"."intended_person_name" = btrim("pair"."intended_person_name"))

private_round_retirement_audit_consisten.name: private_round_retirement_audit_consistent
private_round_retirement_audit_consisten.value: ("private_round"."status" = 'open' and "private_round"."retired_by_participant_id" is null and "private_round"."retired_at" is null) or ("private_round"."status" = 'retired' and "private_round"."retired_by_participant_id" is not null and "private_round"."retired_at" is not null)

question_lifecycle_withdrawal_reason_req.name: question_lifecycle_withdrawal_reason_required
question_lifecycle_withdrawal_reason_req.value: "question_lifecycle_event"."action" <> 'revision_withdrawn' or ("question_lifecycle_event"."revision_id" is not null and "question_lifecycle_event"."reason" is not null and char_length(btrim("question_lifecycle_event"."reason")) > 0)

question_revision_category_relationship_.name: question_revision_category_relationship_fit_valid
question_revision_category_relationship_.value: ("question_revision"."category" not in ('relationship', 'friendship')) or ("question_revision"."category" = 'relationship' and "question_revision"."relationship_fit" = 'partner') or ("question_revision"."category" = 'friendship' and "question_revision"."relationship_fit" = 'friend')
